projects.title: Crafting Life
projects.description: Crafting Life is a element crafting game which requires players to collect elements through a fast-paced sorting mini game. Sort the correct elements into their assigned zones to gather them, or lose them all if you place an element into the wrong zones. These gathered elements can then be combined to discover new increasingly complex objects, and eventually life. Using a mix of pressured decision-making and ingenious combinations, Crafting Life offers discovery through quick thinking. Collect all of the elements to win!
